whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Mani Martial Art's Academy,

I noticed your academy has exceptional 5.0★ reviews in Kurji, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new student admissions and batch inquiries.

Maine aapke martial arts academy ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, self-defense programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/manimartialarts

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Mani Martial Art's Academy Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your top-rated self-defense classes in Kurji. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact training timings aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
